issues.description: Element: SQL query in solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql. Problem statement (problem_statement.md line 122) requires the result to be aggregated and grouped by the column 'regierungsbezirk'. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql lines 1-3) selects regierungsbezirk and aggregated sums but uses 'GROUP BY kreis'. Selecting 'regierungsbezirk' while grouping by 'kreis' is inconsistent: it is invalid in strict SQL or yields ambiguous / incorrect results in permissive SQL dialects. This mismatch between the intended grouping column (regierungsbezirk) and the solution's GROUP BY (kreis) will confuse students about which column to group by and may produce a failing query or wrong aggregation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the grouping column consistent with the problem statement. Update the solution to group by regierungsbezirk instead of kreis. For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk; (Alternatively, if the intended grouping was by kreis, update the problem statement to ask for grouping by kreis and adjust the SELECT list accordingly.)
